review_result: No remaining material gap found within the declared readout/evidence boundary after the corrections below.

corrections.finding: Reference-mode source_v is the analytic reduced velocity envelope, not the injected timing waveform.
corrections.resolution: Always reduced_model; classify psi_tau/source_fwhm separately from timing-specific reference_fwhm/emission-lifetime metadata.

corrections.finding: Both Cs reference channels have no reference_bandwidth_mhz and source code uses an assumed300MHz fallback; unrelated OD/g2 references incorrectly made its origin reference_anchored.
corrections.resolution: Predictive bandwidth depends on psi_tau; nonpredictive bandwidth is its own stored reference input or explicit assumed_input300MHz fallback, with no waveform dependency.

corrections.finding: Pre-calibration fields were grouped with final target-g2 added-background results.
corrections.resolution: Raw outputs are detector_derived and depend on pre-calibration quantities; final g2 may separately depend on target_g2_peak.

corrections.finding: Grouping histogram correlation and finite-gate CAR obscured their different window dependence.
corrections.resolution: Histogram g2 depends on normalized waveform, all-time coincidence and singles, plus optional target; CAR depends on gate-captured coincidence and accidentals; raw accidental rate explicitly includes gate width.
